paragraphs.text: Edit generated HTML on the rendered page inside the DSH sidebar.
# DSH HTML Visual Editor
Edit a generated HTML file **on the rendered page itself** — no source code view.
English · 中文

When an agent writes a report to `.html`, DeepSeek Harness shows it as source code.
This plugin adds

a file viewer for `dsh-better-sidebar` that renders the document
and lets you edit the text, format

ting and layout in place, then writes the result
back to the same file.
## Install
This plugin renders inside the **DSH Better Sidebar**, so install that first:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The install comes straight from this repository; the published bundle
(`lib/client.js`) is committed

, so there is no build step and no build-script
approval to grant.

`dsh-better-sidebar` 0.28.0 or newer is required. Without it the plugin stays
inert — it never break

s the app. Nothing else is started: no local server, no
browser extension, no API key, no network ca

ng else is started: no local server, no
browser extension, no API key, no network call at edit time.
## Use

1. Open a `.html` / `.htm` file in the right sidebar. The document renders as a page.
2. Press **Edi

t** in the sidebar header. The page becomes directly editable.
3. Select text to apply bold, italic,

underline, heading level, font size, text
colour, highlight, alignment, lists and links. Undo/redo

work as usual.
4. Press the **save** button in the header, or `Ctrl/Cmd+S` inside the page.
This is

the only step that writes to the file — there is no autosave.
5. **Preview** shows your unsaved draf
t again without losing it.

**Rollback:** turn off “HTML 可视化编辑” in the sidebar settings’ viewer list, or
uninstall the plugin. T
he built-in HTML viewer returns; no other plugin is touched.
## What it saves

For a complete document with an explicit `<body>`, only the body is replaced. The
original doctype,

`<head>` (including CSS, links and scripts), the body attributes
and everything after `</body>` are

preserved byte for byte. Scripts inside the body
are kept, but they never run in the editor.
## Safety

- The preview runs in an iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` and **without**
`allow-same-origin`,

so the document gets an opaque origin.
- The page’s own scripts, event handlers, forms, frames and o

utbound connections
are blocked. Only one nonce-bearing bridge script of this plugin may run.
- The

parent window talks to the frame over a single `MessageChannel` port, checked
against the window sou

rce, the opaque origin and a per-load random token.
- Saving goes through the sidebar’s existing aut

henticated write endpoint, so its
request fence, file policies, encoding handling and mtime conflict

check apply.
A conflicting change is reported and never overwritten silently.
- Your HTML is not wr

itten to `localStorage`, not uploaded, and not sent to any AI
service. Unsaved drafts live in memory

for the current session only (five at most).
- The sidebar service is acquired lazily, so installin

g this plugin without
`dsh-better-sidebar` leaves it inert instead of breaking the app.
## Limits

- Built for generated static reports, articles and assignment HTML — not a page
design tool. There i

s no drag-and-drop layout, no image replacement, no AI rewrite.
- Pages that build their DOM at runt

ime (React/Vue apps, chart interactions) cannot
be edited this way; open the original file in a brow

ser for those.
- The body is re-serialised by the browser, so indentation, quoting style and other
n

ormalisation details may change. Byte-identical output is not promised for
arbitrary HTML.
- Documen

ts above 5 MiB are read-only. Without a reliable mtime the document can be
edited and exported, but

not written back.
- Closing a sidebar tab cannot be intercepted reliably; export the draft before yo

back.
- Closing a sidebar tab cannot be intercepted reliably; export the draft before you
close it.

# 中文说明
在 DSH 右侧栏里**直接编辑渲染后的 HTML 页面**，而不是切换到源码视图。

当智能体生成一份 `.html` 报告时，DeepSeek Harness 默认按源码显示它。本插件为
`dsh-better-sidebar` 提供一个文件查看器：先把文档渲染成页面，再让你在页面上

直接
改文字、改格式，改完写回同一个文件。
## 安装
本插件渲染在 **DSH Better Sidebar** 里，请先安装它：
[代码示例省略，未执行]

安装直接来自本仓库；构建产物（`lib/client.js`）已随仓库提交，因此没有构建步骤，
也不需要批准任何安装期脚本。

需要 `dsh-better-sidebar` 0.28.0 或更新版本。若未安装，本插件保持静默，不会影响
[该节后续省略]
## 安全

- 预览运行在 `sandbox="allow-scripts"` 且**不包含** `allow-same-origin` 的 iframe 中，
文档因此是不透明来源（opaque origin）

。
- 原页面的脚本、事件处理器、表单、内嵌页面与主动连接全部被阻止，只有本插件带
nonce 的引导脚本可以运行。
- 父子页面通过单条 `MessageChannel` 端口通信，并校验窗口来源、

不透明来源与每次
加载随机生成的 token。
- 保存走侧栏已有的鉴权写接口，继承它的请求防护、文件策略、编码处理与 mtime 冲突
检查；文件被外部修改时会提示冲突，绝不静默覆盖。
- 你的 H

TML 不写入 `localStorage`、不上传、也不发给任何 AI 服务。未保存草稿只存在
于当前会话内存中（最多五份）。
- 侧栏服务是延迟获取的：没装 `dsh-better-sidebar

age`、不上传、也不发给任何 AI 服务。未保存草稿只存在
于当前会话内存中（最多五份）。
- 侧栏服务是延迟获取的：没装 `dsh-better-sidebar` 时本插件保持静默，不会弄坏宿主。
## 限制

- 面向生成的静态报告、文章、作业 HTML，不是网页设计器：不提供拖拽布局、替换图片
与 AI 改写。
- 运行时生成 DOM 的页面（React/Vue 应用、图表交互）无法这样编辑，请用浏览器打

开
原文件。
- body 会经浏览器重新序列化，缩进、引号风格等规范化细节可能变化，不承诺任意
HTML 字节级无损。
- 超过 5 MiB 的文档只读；没有可靠 mtime 时可编辑、可导出，但不

能写盘。
- 宿主无法可靠拦截侧栏标签的关闭动作，关闭前请先导出草稿。
